authorization: Prepare a minimal prospective and wrapper only. Canonical build execution requires the root-state-policy.v2.json gate and a separate root GO after accepted R2303 review and root full-read of these exact files.

capture_wrapper.signal_qualification: possible-signal classification is inferred from shell exit status >128; this is not independent OS-level signal instrumentation.

build_flow_from_previously_reviewed_runn: Resolve checkpoint as canonical build root and run bootstrap.
Validate configured Node and pinned Bazel versions.
Invoke the configured absolute Bazel executable in batch mode to build //:site.
count_interpretation: Historical named helper/targeted/full groups may overlap. Historical counts are not E2304 predictions or observations and must not be summed. Report only fresh actual named summaries from the authorized run.
stop_policy: After a distinct execution GO, run the wrapper once. Preserve original stdout/stderr, actual UTC bounds, actual exit, and qualified possible-signal classification. Stop on the first unexpected failure; no retry, cache reenactment, source/test edits, assertion weakening, environment/flag/config changes, permission changes, Git, or publication. This prospective is unrun.
